title: Deeper/broader peer-advertised scope and ACIS authoring readiness review
mode: primary-source repository/documentation research and local plan reconciliation
scope: Compare DWG/DXF peer claims against their detailed version, entity, writer, and validation caveats
Refresh the obj2cad discovery-stage ACIS/DXF authoring candidate and its DWG lineage
Separate strict parse, recovery/audit, emitted carrier, native acceptance, and semantic geometry evidence
Refine the existing composed peer checkpoint without changing implementation order or validation frequency

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project manuals, repository documentation, and current local plans/tests
method.limitations: Peer conclusions are based on public manuals/README/source-page descriptions and repository-visible state, not installed release binaries or runtime experiments. The obj2cad ACIS writer, dependency graph, and harness implementation were not source-audited in this pass; its stated cross-read and surface-vertex checks are therefore candidate evidence only. Mutable master documentation is not attributed automatically to a released artifact.

sources.observed: The overview describes approximately 99% coverage, while detailed sections list unhandled AcDs classes, families with no test coverage, and unstable/undertested classes. The manual states R2007 DWG writing is unavailable and R2010-R2018 output may fail CRC and CAD audit checks. Aggregate coverage and version labels cannot qualify a particular record, operation, or output artifact.

sources.revision: Public compatibility documentation and changelog reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project describes DXF/DXB read/write through R2014, lists MESH, MLEADER, SURFACE, TABLE, and VIEWPORT as gaps, and warns that 3DSOLID/BODY/REGION and other writers may not produce AutoCAD-openable output. This supports only scoped structural comparison, not native writer acceptance or ACIS semantics.

The drawing add-on explicitly does not render ACIS and has no 3D rendering engine; the documentation describes separate strict-read/recovery/audit workflows and an ACIS browser/export route. A recovered parse or XY projection is not a 3D semantic oracle.

sources.revision: Current README and repository page reviewed 2026-10-18; public page listed 21 commits and no GitHub release
sources.observed: The README calls the project pre-release, labels ASCII/Binary DXF verified and DWG/curved surfaces beta until AutoCAD acceptance, describes a SAT/SAB ACIS writer, known analytic-body controls, and readback/surface-vertex checks. Its DWG crate uses a patched ACadRust writer. The README does not establish complete closed-body validity, native acceptance, AcDs ownership, or an independent DWG route; the ACIS source and test harness were not audited or executed in this pass.

assessment.planImpact: Adds an operation-specific peer-role matrix and a composed-only readiness recipe for a possible obj2cad scratch control author. It bars aggregate coverage percentages, typed entity presence, recovery success, ACIS carrier inspection, and peer self-roundtrips from promoting native or semantic support claims. The local PAR-40 / 7G.2 queue and fast per-slice validation cadence are unchanged.

implementationReadyChecks: Bind each peer result to the exact source commit/release, runtime, version, operation, record family, emitted artifact, and verifier.
Track source inventory through parse, output, and reopen, including owner/block/handle closure, warnings, recoveries, repairs, and explicit omissions.
Use LibreDWG only for the exact writer versions/operations whose detailed caveats and output checks permit; do not infer family support from the 99% summary.
Use IxMilia.Dxf and ezdxf only for their scoped structural/tag/carrier roles; do not count typed 3DSOLID or XY rendering as native 3D acceptance.
If obj2cad is triggered at the existing composed checkpoint, pin and audit source, dependency/license graph, ACIS profile, and harness before generating scratch-only controls.
For generated ACIS controls, compare independently specified complete-body and analytic geometry properties; treat vertex checks or raw carrier parsing as partial evidence.
Do not use the ACadRust-derived obj2cad DWG route as an independent DWG/AcDs peer; keep AcDs owner-to-payload proof separate.
Keep strict parse, recovery/audit, write success, native audit, and semantic checks as distinct results; do not run peers in every local implementation slice.

Do not add dependencies or commit third-party/customer test drawings; keep generated comparison artifacts in scratch unless independently authored locally and explicitly approved by the fixture policy.
